definition: Actual executable exchange product and quote currency
caveat: Do not substitute a reference-price endpoint for product availability

definition: Timestamp at which all features were available
caveat: Preserve point-in-time universe membership; coverage start/end alone does not establish listing lifecycle or continuity

definition: Quote-currency value of each planned order
caveat: Liquidity and costs depend on size

definition: Buy and sell fees plus nonduplicated execution costs at planned size
caveat: Include stress estimates and actual fee tier

definition: Planned percentage spacing divided by modeled round-trip percentage cost
caveat: Three times cost is a testable starting heuristic, not an established optimum

definition: Actually executable paired cycles with costs applied
caveat: Do not count every level touch as a filled cycle

definition: Absolute net log price change / sum of absolute consecutive log price changes
caveat: Zero path length is undefined; sampling and bid/ask bounce matter; not standalone proof

definition: Share of next test window inside a band selected using prior data
caveat: No full-sample fitting of the band

definition: Time below the lower band in future test windows
caveat: Include unresolved escapes

definition: Base order plus all planned averaging orders and cost buffer
caveat: Sum overlapping bot requirements under joint selloffs

definition: Fraction reaching specified fee-adjusted basket exit by a fixed horizon
caveat: Unresolved positions count as not hit at horizon

definition: Time to target after actual ladder fills
caveat: Preserve right-censoring and time underwater

definition: Worst liquidation-value decline before exit or evaluation end
caveat: Evaluate entire basket, not initial entry alone

definition: Recorded ownership rationale and conditions that invalidate it
caveat: Historical price oscillation cannot establish future expected appreciation

definition: Dollar amounts and dates funds become available
caveat: Do not compare against unavailable upfront capital

definition: Change in cash plus liquidatable marked inventory net of cash flows and costs
caveat: Use full allocated/reserved capital; preserve daily equity curve

definition: Largest peak-to-trough decline in strategy equity on consistent cash-flow basis
caveat: Closed-trade profit is insufficient

definition: Duration below prior strategy-equity high
caveat: Include ongoing episodes

definition: Performance/rank of the complete prior-data selection procedure in later windows
caveat: Count all tried features, parameters and refit cadences

definition: Funding shortfall when correlated positions demand reserves together
caveat: Do not treat nominal ticker count as independent diversification

definition: Record return methodology and dated external contributions/withdrawals on a defined portfolio boundary
caveat: TWR and MWR answer different questions; preserve funded reserve cash and valuation times

definition: Compare strategy and benchmark with consistent cash-flow history, horizon and return convention
caveat: Do not compare a time-weighted index number directly with investor money-weighted performance
